status: frozen before AGC 2023 archive access and before AGC 2024 indoor-outcome access

compute_policy.large_download_rule: report name, purpose, size, destination and smaller alternative; require explicit user approval before download
compute_policy.heavy_run_rule: run a short smoke test first and report expected load before sustained simulation

greenlight_original_evaluation.permitted_claim: the local GreenLight implementation reproduces the original evaluation workflow/error scale
greenlight_original_evaluation.forbidden_claim: facility-specific validity for AGC 2019 or AGC 2024

agc2019.status: all frozen v8 temporal holdout outcomes have been opened
agc2019.permitted_claim: development evidence only; never reused as prospective validation for v9

agc2023_pretrial.outcome_policy: outcomes may be opened only after an input/schema audit records source hashes and confirms the archive role; they can never serve as v9 validation

agc2024_challenge.status: schema and permitted inputs audited; direct indoor temperature, RH, humidity-deficit and CO2 values remain unopened
agc2024_challenge.selection_policy: identities and periods may be chosen only from input completeness and timestamps
agc2024_challenge.opening_policy: do not access indoor outcomes until the v9 model/ensemble, hashes, initial-state rule, identities, metrics, thresholds and one-shot handling are committed

counterfactual_claim_rule: AGC 2024 trajectory agreement under observed equipment states does not by itself validate arbitrary counterfactual actions. Counterfactual conclusions must remain stable over the frozen physically plausible parameter ensemble and within declared action support.
